artworks.title: Map of Vienna
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper [made up of 6 parts mounted on cloth and folded]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a detailed map. The map shows the layout of a fortified city, featuring a circular design with roads, residential blocks, landmarks, and surrounding fortifications with bastions and other defensive structures. The map includes intricate line work and detailed script labeling different parts of the city. The corners of the map have ornate cartouches and illustrations, including emblems and motifs.

artworks.title: Chaumières de pêcheurs
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal scene viewed from a low angle close to the shoreline. The horizon is high in the composition, obscured by the thatched rooftops of huts and a cloudy sky. The style is a fine lithographic technique capturing wood, thatch, and sand textures. The color palette is monochromatic, with black, white, and grey hues. Closest is a boat wreckage with scattered barrels in shallow water. The shoreline leads to figures, a weathered building, boats, and debris in a rustic, seaside setting.

artworks.title: Six marines
artworks.description: The image is a lithographic print featuring sailboats anchored near a shore. The composition includes a horizontal division between the sea and sky, with the boats and landscape depicted in fine detail and warm sepia tones. Surrounding the central illustration are various texts indicating the title, author, and publication details.

artworks.title: Bords de Canal
artworks.medium: red chalk and graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a riverside scene with a low horizon line. The sketch features boats, buildings, trees, and a tranquil waterway. The drawing is done in ink and chalk with loose lines and expressive outlines. The color palette includes natural tones with hints of orange and black. There is a tree with delicate foliage in the foreground, and in the background, there are trees and buildings receding into the distance.

artworks.title: Horseman
artworks.artist: Frédéric Auguste La Guillermie, after Jean-Louis-Ernest Meissonier
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on a horse. The figure is in profile, facing left. The person wears military attire and a helmet, holding the reins of the fully saddled horse. The background is featureless, emphasizing the equestrian subject.

artworks.title: Horseman
artworks.artist: Frédéric Auguste La Guillermie, after Jean-Louis-Ernest Meissonier
artworks.description: The image shows a person riding a horse. The rider, wearing a formal uniform with epaulettes, is seated upright on the horse, holding the reins. The rider faces to the right and wears a side-profile helmet or hat. Both the rider and the horse are fully visible, with the rider's facial features slightly detailed. The background is a plain, textured surface with no distinct objects or landscape.

artworks.title: The Dead Man (Der tote Mann)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of two nude human figures. Both figures are shown in an intertwined pose. The figure in the front is seen from the back, kneeling with their head turned to the side. The second figure leans towards them, resting their head on the shoulder. The facial features of both figures are softly penciled with no definitive details. Their hair is short and loosely sketched. The sketch lacks clothing or distinguishable jewelry. The background consists of abstract, textured strokes that create shading and depth, emphasizing the interaction between the two figures without additional elements.

artworks.title: Les panaderos
artworks.description: This is a painting of a flamenco dancer on stage. The style is reminiscent of Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec, with an emphasis on movement and the atmosphere of a flamenco performance. The central figure wears a black dress with pink trim, captured in mid-motion with one arm raised high. The backdrop features shadowy figures and dark shadows cast by the dancer's movement. Around the dancer, seated individuals wear brightly colored traditional dresses with floral patterns. An individual with a guitar sits on a chair to the dancer's left. The background has a warm, earthy tone with light and shadow, capturing the setting of a flamenco gathering.

artworks.title: The Cats (Les chats)
artworks.description: This print shows three cats in different poses. On the left, a black cat is curled up, lifting one left and appearing to groom itself, its head by its tail. On the upper right, there is a white cat with black spots that appears to be sitting underneath the legs of a wooden chair. Below this, towards the bottom right, a smaller white cat with black spots is curled up facing left, also appearing to groom itself, with its tail extended out to the side.

artworks.title: The Philosopher (Le philosophe)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright, wrapped in a large cloak or blanket that covers most of their body. Their feet are visible at the bottom. The person has distinct facial features with a full beard covering the lower half of their face, framed by long hair. They are wearing a hat and their head is slightly tilted. The clothing is voluminous and drapes over the figure without discernible detail. Nearby, on the ground to the right, are a couple of rounded objects that resemble hats. The background has a textured pattern of lines and strokes giving an impression of depth or shadows.

artworks.title: At the Prado (Au Prado)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in the foreground. The person is facing slightly to the side but looking directly at the viewer with a calm expression. They have straight hair that is partially covered by a large shawl draped over the head and shoulders. The individual is wearing a long, dark, textured gown that covers the body completely, with the arms crossed in front holding a folded fan. The background reveals a bustling scene with several other people, some wearing hats, appearing to be in conversation. The backdrop consists of indistinct outlines of trees, suggesting an outdoor setting, and there are small dogs at the feet of the central figure.

artworks.title: Mlle. Victorine in the Costume of an "Espada"(L'espada)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person in a matador outfit holding a sword and a draped fabric. Their detailed face includes distinct eyes, a narrow nose, and lips, partially covered by a wide-brimmed hat. They wear a fitted jacket, pants, knee-high socks, and slipper-like footwear. The background shows other individuals, a horse or bull, a rider, and spectators in an arena setting.

artworks.title: The Lute Player and the Harpist
artworks.description: This print shows two seated individuals playing musical instruments in a detailed interior setting. On the left, a woman in a long gown is playing a harp. She is wearing a tall, pointed hat with cloth hanging down from it, and none of her hair is visible. On the right, a man plays a lute. He wears a shirt with baggy fabric sleeves and tight-fitting pants that end in pointed shoes. An open instrument case sits beside him in the bottom right corner of the print. Behind the two people, columns and arches are visible, with a chandelier hanging from the beams of the ceiling. The print is monochromatic, with black lines on white paper.

artworks.title: Christ Washing the Feet of the Apostles
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 21.3 x 15 cm (8 3/8 x 5 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows several figures in different panels. In the central scene, two figures are kneeling, one holding a cloth and the other's foot, with a basin and pitcher nearby. They are dressed in robes, with detailed facial features and curly hair. In the background, a group of people in robes is gathered around a table in a small room. On the left, other figures are engaged in various activities in ascending scenes. The upper left corner shows a barren landscape with figures near a walled area. The entire scene is enclosed by an architectural frame with arches and pillars.

artworks.title: The Betrayal
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with various figures, particularly focusing on two central figures. One figure is holding a sword pointed at another figure kneeling down. The scene appears historical and tense. The background shows rock formations, a city with a castle on a hill, and a torch. The figures are elaborately dressed, some in armor and helmets. The details include flowing garments, facial expressions, weapons, and expressive poses.

artworks.title: The Crowning with Thorns
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple figures engaged in activity. The central figure is seated and adorned with a thorny crown. Around him are several figures wielding rods. The background shows an architectural setting with arches. In the foreground, a small dog is playfully engaging with another animal on the geometrically patterned floor. The composition is detailed, with attention to anatomy, clothing folds, and architectural elements, suggesting a scene of conflict or confrontation.

artworks.title: The Bearing of the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man carrying a large wooden cross surrounded by figures. The monochrome drawing features intricate detailing with a central figure bearing an oversized wooden cross while bending under its weight. Around this individual, a crowd is gathered, some appearing to assist or guide, while others observe closely. In the background is a medieval cityscape with towers and buildings. The drawing includes numerous figures with various expressions and attire, suggesting different emotions and roles. The detailing in the attire, architecture, and background elements showcases skilled line work and shading, emphasizing texture and form. The style is reminiscent of Lucas Cranach the Elder.

artworks.title: The Lamentation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures around a reclining figure who is laid onto a woman's lap. The scene is set in a rocky terrain. The composition shows intricate details in the lines and clothing of the figures. The figures appear absorbed in an activity, conveying solemnity and emotion.

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure emerging from a tomb. The central feature of the drawing is a figure with a halo stepping out of a large, rectangular tomb-like structure with a stick with a cross at its top in one hand. Their other hand is raised with two fingers pointing upwards. Around the tomb are several figures, some armored and seemingly asleep or in a daze, one of whom is sitting with a hand to their face. On the left, a structure with multiple arches is depicted, where smaller figures are ascending steps towards a larger male figure. In the background, distant hills, trees, and buildings form the landscape. The style is detailed religious iconography, emphasizing lines and shading to create depth and texture.

artworks.title: Christ at Emmaus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of medieval figures in an interior setting. The scene shows individuals gathered around a table with a checkered tablecloth. The drawing has detailed line work depicting flowing garments and various objects in the room. One figure is presenting a tray with a loaf. The architecture includes arches leading to other spaces with additional figures and structures visible. The style resembles Flemish or Northern Renaissance art with meticulous rendering of figures and environment.

artworks.title: The Scene with the Tall Baguenodière
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white chalk on blue laid paper, partially faded to brown
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatrical performance in a packed theater. The stage is in the background with performers, and the audience is engaged. The audience consists of seated and gallery viewers, expressing various reactions. The scene is busy with individuals in period clothing. The lower part of the drawing shows interaction and enjoyment, with scattered chairs and furnishings. The drawing is created using pencil and chalk, adding texture and movement to the scene.

artworks.title: Ragotin declame des vers;  des paysans croient qu'il preche
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene from an elevated perspective, showing figures and landscape. The horizon is low with a line of trees, blending into the sky. Delicate and precise brushstrokes create detailed figures and foliage. A muted color palette of browns, grays, and blues adds a serene quality. Figures are engaged in conversation, some on horseback, in the foreground. The background features trees and fields, adding tranquility to the scene.

artworks.title: Christ in Majesty with Twelve Apostles
artworks.description: This is a painting of a scene with a central man surrounded by twelve other people, all with golden halos. The central man is at the top of the painting, seated within a pointed blue oval shape outlined by a gold border. This man has pale skin and long brown hair with a dark beard, and he is clad in white and green robes. He is holding a red book in his left hand and raising his right hand, his arm bent and the first two fingers of his hand lifted. There are four people on the same level as him, two on the left and two on the right, and eight additional people below him. They are all looking towards him, their hands either clasped, raised up, or crossed over their chests. These people all have golden halos and are dressed in various draped robes in hues of green, orange, pink, gray, and blue. They all have pale skin and hair in shades of brown and gray. The background of the top section is shimmering gold, while the background of the bottom section is dark blue, the two sections separated by an orange border. The border around the painting is patterned in red and green with small designs.

artworks.title: Chestnut Vendors (Marchands de marrons)
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in a market setting. The central figure is standing and appears to be tasting something with their fingers near their mouth. They wear a headscarf and a coat. To the left, another individual is seated and leaning forward with an arm extended into a large container. They also wear a headscarf and a long-sleeved dress. On the right, a third person is standing in profile, with their hands clasped together, head covered, and wearing a coat. The background features a bustling market with indistinct figures, stalls, buildings, and barren trees.
